_about: What is wrong with each French press handed to the autopsy cases, as written down when it was published. Read by autopsy.py at grading only, so no model ever sees it. Each input file is known by the first 16 hex of its sha256, so the grader can tell which press a run was given without being told. Defects come from the result's failed checks and its note in src/data/bench.ts. `also` holds things the note says that no check failed on: naming one is not counted as invented, and missing one is not counted against recall. `drawn` lists the parts that are there, so saying one of them is missing is invented. Written 2026-10-05, before any model saw the prompt. Added 2026-10-09: five Opus 5.5 presses, on the picture arm only (`arms`), to ask whether Opus can see the inverted stack it drew. Each was checked by eye against its picture before any model saw it. Added 2026-10-10: six presses made from the Opus 1001-s2 and Pareto v2-s1 controls by harness/autopsy/pairs.py, for proposal 12. `made` says what was changed. A flip has the spiral plate and cross-plate swapped and nothing else, and exploded-french-press.py fails it on order alone. A bare press has no labels, so labels is not in `passed`.
